nodes.statement: On the maximal restriction-stable formal oscillatory infinity module (E,X0,X1,X2), the p=0 current has rank three and a one-dimensional mixed Einstein/additional radical; p=-1 vanishes on it and the first finite p=-2 form is generically nonzero, with exact exceptional locus Q21(ell(ell+1),omega^2)=0.
nodes.scope: real nonzero omega, Lambda=ell(ell+1), ell>=2; canonical reconstruction pivot nonzero on the complete physical domain
